items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: after both Placite and Frog had finished, they played it back for him... with the addition of the trombone and bass

ctx.x: Yeah. That's why I wanted to... Class Stephen Frog had a hard time with this.

Well, Frog, I started to cut the trombone part out of the bridge. You never look at the bridge, man. See, because the chord structure for the New Orleans-style music and the Dixie Land music, I don't know what I'm doing. I don't know what I'm doing. But those guys were the viewer, man. If those guys would ever start thinking for themselves, or get somebody to get there to think for them, they'd be better than American musicians. Who's singing?

That's you? That's the British for you. Well, I'll pick up the British accent. I came back to New Orleans there to get my... Yeah, the Mid-Atlantic accent. This is Spanish Diamond Poets, Mid-Atlantic band.
